name: OmaBeat
author: Dorneles
description: Universal Swatch Internet Time (.beat) widget, real-time converter, and cross-timezone sync tool for the Omarchy status bar.

barWidget.description: Universal Swatch Internet Time (@000 - @999 .beats) without time zones or daylight saving time

schema.label: Badge Style
schema.description: 'flat' transparent background, 'pill' rounded capsule, 'progress' day beat progress fill.

schema.label: Live Centibeats (Sub-beats)
schema.description: Show 2 decimal places ticking in real time (@550.85) in the status bar.

schema.label: Show Swatch Icon
schema.description: Show the @ beat icon before the text in the bar.

schema.label: Show '@' Prefix
schema.description: Show the '@' character before the beat number (e.g. '@550' vs '550').

schema.label: Century Beat Desktop Notifications
schema.description: Send a desktop notification every 100 beats (@100, @200, @300...).

schema.label: Notify on Beat Copy
schema.description: Show a desktop toast when copying current beat to clipboard.
